blocks.text: Ikki fikr bir-biriga zid bo'lsa — birinchisidan kutilgan natija chiqmasa — eng oddiy vosita **but** (→ qizil kitob, 97-dars): It was cold, **but** we went out. Bu darsda xuddi shu ma'noni beradigan yana ikki guruhni o'rganamiz: **although / though / even though** va **in spite of / despite**. O'zbekchada ularga «**-sa ham**», «**-ganiga qaramay**», «**garchi ... bo'lsa-da**», «**... -ga qaramay**» to'g'ri keladi: Charchagan **bo'lsam ham**, ishladim; Yomg'irga **qaramay**, chiqdik.

Ikki guruhning ma'nosi bir xil, farqi — **grammatikada**. **although** guruhi — bog'lovchi: undan keyin to'liq **gap** (ega + fe'l) keladi. **in spite of / despite** — predlog: undan keyin **ot**, **olmosh** yoki fe'lning **-ing** shakli keladi. O'zbekchada bu farq deyarli sezilmaydi («yomg'ir yog'ganiga qaramay» ham, «yomg'irga qaramay» ham bir xil «qaramay» bilan), shuning uchun xatolar aynan shu yerda chiqadi.

rows: **Although** it was cold, we went out.
**Though** it was cold, we went out.
**Even though** it was freezing, we went out.
**In spite of** the cold, we went out.

blocks.text: **although** va **though** bir xil ma'noda; **though** biroz norasmiyroq va og'zaki nutqda ko'proq uchraydi. **even though** — kuchaytirilgan shakl: zidlik yanada kutilmagan ekanini ta'kidlaydi, o'zbekchadagi «**hatto ... bo'lsa ham**», «**bila turib**» ga yaqin (even haqida → 112-dars). Ergash gap bosh gapdan oldin ham, keyin ham kela oladi; oldin kelsa, odatda vergul qo'yiladi. E'tibor bering: although gapidagi voqea **haqiqiy fakt** — u rostdan bo'lgan yoki bo'lyapti.

items.text: **Although** the flat is small, it's in a great location.
items.translation: Kvartira kichik **bo'lsa ham**, joylashuvi juda yaxshi.

items.text: I still trust him, **though** he has let me down before.
items.translation: Ilgari umidimni puchga chiqargan **bo'lsa ham**, unga hali ham ishonaman.

items.text: She went to work **even though** she had a high temperature.
items.translation: Isitmasi baland **bo'lishiga qaramay**, u ishga bordi.

blocks.text: in spite of / despite + ot yoki -ing

**in spite of** va **despite** — sinonim predloglar; **despite** biroz rasmiyroq, yozma nutqda va yangiliklarda ko'proq. Diqqat: **despite** dan keyin **of** qo'yilmaydi, **in spite** dan keyin esa **of** shart. Predlogdan keyin fe'l kelsa, u **-ing** shaklida bo'ladi (→ 60-dars): despite **being** late, in spite of **having** no money. Voqea oldinroq bo'lganini ta'kidlash uchun **having + V3** ham ishlatiladi: despite **having lived** there for years.

items.text: **Despite** the delay, the passengers stayed calm.
**In spite of** being very shy, Jasur gave an excellent speech.
items.translation: Juda uyatchan **bo'lishiga qaramay**, Jasur ajoyib nutq so'zladi.

items.text: They bought the house **despite** having doubts about the area.
items.translation: Mahalla haqida shubhalari **bo'lishiga qaramay**, ular uyni sotib olishdi.

blocks.text: Gapni otga aylantirish: the fact that

in spite of / despite dan keyin to'liq gap qo'ymoqchi bo'lsangiz, oraga **the fact that** («... ekanligi») qo'shiladi: despite **the fact that** + gap. Bu shakl uzunroq va rasmiyroq — yozma nutqda, hisobot va yangiliklarda ko'p. Shunday qilib, bitta fikrni bir necha xil aytish mumkin:

rows: **Although** the tickets were expensive, the hall was full.
**Despite** the high prices, the hall was full.
**Despite** costing a lot, the tickets sold out in an hour.
**Despite the fact that** the tickets were expensive, the hall was full.
in spite of the fact that + gap
The hall was full **in spite of the fact that** the tickets were expensive.

blocks.text: **-ing** shakli bilan gapning egasi bir xil bo'lishi kerak: **Despite being** tired, I finished the report (charchagan ham, tugatgan ham — men). Ega boshqa bo'lsa, ot yoki the fact that ishlating: **Despite the fact that** the children were noisy, I finished the report.

Og'zaki nutqda **though** gap oxirida ham keladi — bunda u **however** («biroq», «shunday bo'lsa ham») ma'nosida bo'lib, oldingi gapga qarshi fikr qo'shadi. Oldidan odatda vergul qo'yiladi. Bu vazifada faqat **though** ishlatiladi: although va even though gap oxirida kelmaydi. O'zbekchaga «**lekin**», «**biroq**», «**esa**», «**-ku**» bilan o'giriladi.

items.text: The exam was hard. I think I passed, **though**.
Our neighbours are quite noisy. They're very kind people, **though**.
items.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz ancha shovqinli. **Biroq** ular juda mehribon odamlar.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «**Although** it was late, **but** we continued.» — o'zbekchada «garchi kech bo'lsa ham, **lekin**...» deyish tabiiy, inglizchada esa although va but bitta gapda birga kelmaydi: **Although** it was late, we continued. yoki It was late, **but** we continued. 2) «**Despite of** the rain» → **Despite** the rain / **In spite of** the rain. 3) «**Although** the rain, we went out» → although dan keyin gap kerak: **Although it was raining**, ... 4) «**Despite** he was tired» → **Despite being** tired / **Despite the fact that** he was tired.

Tanlash usuli: keyingi qismga qarang. **Ega + fe'l** (it was, he had, they live) bo'lsa — **although / though / even though**; **ot** yoki **-ing** (the rain, his age, being tired) bo'lsa — **despite / in spite of**. «of» ni eslab qolish: **despite** — bitta so'z, of siz; **in spite of** — uch so'z, of bilan.

**even though** va **even if** ni adashtirmang (→ 112-dars). **even though** — fakt: **Even though** I'm busy, I'll help you (bandman — bu rost). **even if** — faraz: **Even if** I'm busy, I'll help you (band bo'lishim mumkin, baribir yordam beraman).

rows: **Even though** I was exhausted, I helped.
despite / in spite of the fact that + gap
**In spite of the fact that** I was tired, I helped.

examples.title: **Although** + clause: a surprising result
examples.description: although dan keyin to'liq gap (ega + fe'l) keladi; natija kutilganiga zid. Ergash gap boshida ham, o'rtasida ham turishi mumkin.

sentences.text: **Although** Aziz studied hard for weeks, he failed his driving theory test.
sentences.translation: Aziz haftalab astoydil tayyorlangan **bo'lsa ham**, haydovchilik nazariya imtihonidan o'ta olmadi.

sentences.text: The trip to Khiva was unforgettable **although** the heat was almost unbearable.
sentences.translation: Jazirama deyarli chidab bo'lmas darajada **bo'lsa ham**, Xivaga sayohat unutilmas bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Although** she earns a good salary, Sarah never seems to have any money.
sentences.translation: Sara yaxshi maosh **olsa ham**, uning hech qachon puli bo'lmaydiganga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: I couldn't sleep **although** I was exhausted after the long flight.
sentences.translation: Uzoq parvozdan keyin holdan toygan **bo'lsam ham**, uxlay olmadim.

sentences.text: Bekzod accepted the job in London **although** it meant leaving his family behind.
sentences.translation: Bu oilasidan uzoqda yashash degani **bo'lsa ham**, Bekzod Londondagi ishni qabul qildi.

sentences.text: **Although** the shop was advertising a big sale, most prices were exactly the same.
sentences.translation: Do'kon katta chegirma haqida reklama qilayotgan **bo'lsa ham**, ko'p narxlar avvalgidek edi.

sentences.text: The film got terrible reviews, **although** I personally found it quite entertaining.
sentences.translation: Filmga juda yomon taqrizlar yozildi, **holbuki** menga shaxsan u ancha qiziqarli tuyuldi.

sentences.text: Nobody was hurt in the accident, **although** both cars were badly damaged.
sentences.translation: Ikkala mashina qattiq shikastlangan **bo'lsa ham**, avariyada hech kim jarohat olmadi.

sentences.text: My grandfather still walks five kilometres a day **although** he is nearly ninety.
sentences.translation: Bobom deyarli to'qson yoshda **bo'lsa ham**, hali ham kuniga besh kilometr piyoda yuradi.

sentences.text: Half the team forgot about the meeting, **although** it had been arranged weeks earlier.
sentences.translation: Uchrashuv bir necha hafta oldin belgilangan **bo'lsa ham**, jamoaning yarmi uni unutib qo'ydi.

examples.title: **Though** and **even though**
examples.description: though — although ning norasmiyroq sinonimi; even though — kuchliroq zidlik, o'zbekchadagi «bila turib», «hatto ... bo'lsa ham».

sentences.text: **Though** it was already midnight, the streets of Tashkent were still busy.
sentences.translation: Yarim tun **bo'lishiga qaramay**, Toshkent ko'chalari hali ham gavjum edi.

sentences.text: Madina kept smiling, **though** she was clearly nervous before the interview.
sentences.translation: Suhbat oldidan aniq hayajonlanayotgan **bo'lsa ham**, Madina jilmayishda davom etdi.

sentences.text: **Even though** I left home an hour early, I still missed my train.
sentences.translation: Uydan bir soat erta **chiqqan bo'lsam ham**, baribir poyezdga ulgurmadim.

sentences.text: James refused to see a doctor **even though** his back was getting worse every day.
sentences.translation: Beli kundan kunga yomonlashayotgan **bo'lsa-da**, Jeyms shifokorga borishdan bosh tortdi.

sentences.text: The concert was completely sold out **even though** the tickets were very expensive.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar juda qimmat **bo'lsa ham**, konsertga hamma chipta sotilib ketdi.

sentences.text: Nilufar speaks excellent English, **though** she has never been abroad.
sentences.translation: Nilufar hech qachon chet elda **bo'lmagan bo'lsa ham**, ingliz tilida a'lo gapiradi.

sentences.text: We decided to go camping **even though** the forecast said it would rain.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotida yomg'ir yog'adi deyilgan **bo'lsa ham**, chodirda dam olishga qaror qildik.

sentences.text: **Even though** Oliver apologised several times, Kate didn't speak to him for a week.
sentences.translation: Oliver bir necha marta kechirim **so'raganiga qaramay**, Keyt u bilan bir hafta gaplashmadi.

sentences.text: The old laptop still works perfectly, **though** it's almost ten years old.
sentences.translation: Eski noutbuk deyarli o'n yillik **bo'lsa ham**, hali ham a'lo ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Why did you lend him money **even though** you knew he never pays anyone back?
sentences.translation: U hech kimga qarzini qaytarmasligini **bila turib**, nega unga pul qarz berding?

examples.title: **In spite of** + noun or -ing
examples.description: in spite of — predlog: undan keyin ot, olmosh yoki -ing shakli keladi. of tushib qolmaydi.

sentences.text: **In spite of** the heavy traffic, we got to the airport with time to spare.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlikka **qaramay**, aeroportga vaqtimiz ortgan holda yetib keldik.

sentences.text: The match went ahead **in spite of** the strong wind and rain.
sentences.translation: Kuchli shamol va yomg'irga **qaramay**, o'yin o'tkazildi.

sentences.text: **In spite of** his age, my uncle has just learned to pay his bills online.
sentences.translation: Yoshiga **qaramay**, amakim yaqinda to'lovlarini onlayn qilishni o'rgandi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza got the job **in spite of** having very little experience.
sentences.translation: Tajribasi juda kam **bo'lishiga qaramay**, Dilnoza ishga qabul qilindi.

sentences.text: The company made a profit last year **in spite of** all the problems with suppliers.
sentences.translation: Yetkazib beruvchilar bilan bog'liq barcha muammolarga **qaramay**, kompaniya o'tgan yili foyda ko'rdi.

sentences.text: Tom gave his presentation and answered every question **in spite of** feeling ill.
sentences.translation: O'zini yomon **his qilishiga qaramay**, Tom taqdimotini o'tkazdi va har bir savolga javob berdi.

sentences.text: Many people still smoke **in spite of** the warnings on every packet.
sentences.translation: Har bir qutidagi ogohlantirishlarga **qaramay**, ko'p odamlar hali ham chekadi.

sentences.text: She remained calm **in spite of** everything that had happened that morning.
sentences.translation: O'sha kuni ertalab bo'lib o'tgan hamma narsaga **qaramay**, u xotirjam qoldi.

sentences.text: Emma managed to order lunch at the bazaar **in spite of** not speaking a word of Uzbek.
sentences.translation: O'zbekcha bir og'iz ham **bilmasligiga qaramay**, Emma bozorda tushlik buyurtma qila oldi.

sentences.text: Did they really go hiking in the mountains **in spite of** the snow warning?
sentences.translation: Qor haqidagi ogohlantirishga **qaramay**, ular rostdan ham tog'ga sayrga borishdimi?

examples.title: **Despite** + noun or -ing: despite being, despite having
examples.description: despite — in spite of ning sinonimi, lekin of siz. Fe'l kelsa — -ing yoki having + V3 (oldinroq bo'lgan voqea).

sentences.text: **Despite** the rain, thousands of people came to the festival in the park.
sentences.translation: Yomg'irga **qaramay**, bog'dagi festivalga minglab odam keldi.

sentences.text: The plane took off **despite** thick fog over the airport.
sentences.translation: Aeroport ustidagi quyuq tumanga **qaramay**, samolyot havoga ko'tarildi.

sentences.text: **Despite** being the youngest in the team, Jasur often leads the meetings.
sentences.translation: Jamoadagi eng yosh xodim **bo'lishiga qaramay**, Jasur ko'pincha yig'ilishlarni olib boradi.

sentences.text: Sarah was refused a visa **despite** having booked her flights and hotel months in advance.
sentences.translation: Aviachipta va mehmonxonani oylar oldin bron **qilganiga qaramay**, Saraga viza berilmadi.

sentences.text: We couldn't persuade him to change his mind **despite** all our efforts.
sentences.translation: Barcha harakatlarimizga **qaramay**, uni fikridan qaytara olmadik.

sentences.text: Prices continued to rise **despite** the government's promises.
sentences.translation: Hukumatning va'dalariga **qaramay**, narxlar oshishda davom etdi.

sentences.text: He went to work **despite** not having slept at all the night before.
sentences.translation: Oldingi kecha umuman **uxlamaganiga qaramay**, u ishga bordi.

sentences.text: **Despite** living in Manchester for ten years, Aziz still struggles with the local accent.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda o'n yil **yashaganiga qaramay**, Aziz hali ham mahalliy shevani qiynalib tushunadi.

sentences.text: The restaurant is always full **despite** its rather high prices.
sentences.translation: Narxlari ancha baland **bo'lishiga qaramay**, restoran doim to'la bo'ladi.

sentences.text: How did the team win **despite** losing two of its best players in the first half?
sentences.translation: Birinchi taymda eng yaxshi ikki o'yinchisidan **ayrilganiga qaramay**, jamoa qanday qilib g'alaba qozondi?

examples.title: **Despite the fact that** / **in spite of the fact that**
examples.description: Predlogdan keyin to'liq gap kerak bo'lsa — the fact that qo'shiladi. Rasmiyroq uslub: hisobot, yangiliklar, yozma nutq.

sentences.text: **Despite the fact that** he was tired, Bekzod drove all the way to Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Charchagan **bo'lishiga qaramay**, Bekzod Samarqandgacha butun yo'lni o'zi haydadi.

sentences.text: The project was a success **in spite of the fact that** we had a tiny budget.
sentences.translation: Byudjetimiz juda kichik **bo'lganiga qaramay**, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli chiqdi.

sentences.text: **In spite of the fact that** it was a public holiday, the bank was open.
sentences.translation: Bayram kuni **bo'lishiga qaramay**, bank ochiq edi.

sentences.text: Many students choose this university **despite the fact that** the fees are high.
sentences.translation: To'lov-kontrakt yuqori **bo'lishiga qaramay**, ko'p talabalar shu universitetni tanlaydi.

sentences.text: **Despite the fact that** nobody had invited him, Oliver turned up at the party.
sentences.translation: Uni hech kim taklif **qilmagan bo'lsa ham**, Oliver ziyofatga kelib qoldi.

sentences.text: She still believes him, **in spite of the fact that** he has lied to her many times.
sentences.translation: Yigit unga ko'p marta yolg'on **gapirganiga qaramay**, qiz hali ham unga ishonadi.

sentences.text: The old factory is still running **despite the fact that** most of its machines date from the 1970s.
sentences.translation: Uskunalarining ko'pi 1970-yillardan **qolganiga qaramay**, eski zavod hali ham ishlab turibdi.

sentences.text: I passed the exam **in spite of the fact that** I hadn't revised much.
sentences.translation: Unchalik ko'p takrorlamagan **bo'lsam ham**, imtihondan o'tdim.

sentences.text: Few tourists know about the museum, **despite the fact that** entry is free.
sentences.translation: Kirish bepul **bo'lishiga qaramay**, muzey haqida kam sayyoh biladi.

sentences.text: Is it true that Kate got the promotion **despite the fact that** she'd only been there a year?
sentences.translation: Keyt u yerda bor-yo'g'i bir yil **ishlaganiga qaramay**, lavozimi oshirilgani rostmi?

examples.title: **Though** at the end: = however
examples.description: Og'zaki nutqda though gap oxirida keladi va oldingi fikrga qarshi fikr qo'shadi. O'zbekchada «lekin», «biroq», «esa», «holbuki».

sentences.text: The hotel was rather old-fashioned. The breakfast was excellent, **though**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona ancha eskicha edi. Nonushtasi **esa** a'lo edi.

sentences.text: I don't really enjoy my new job. The salary is good, **though**.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishim menga unchalik yoqmaydi. **Lekin** maoshi yaxshi.

sentences.text: It's a lovely flat — isn't it a bit far from the metro, **though**?
sentences.translation: Ajoyib kvartira — **lekin** metrodan biroz uzoq emasmi?

sentences.text: We lost the final. It was still a great season, **though**, and we're proud of the team.
sentences.translation: Finalda yutqazdik. **Shunday bo'lsa ham**, mavsum ajoyib o'tdi va jamoamiz bilan faxrlanamiz.

sentences.text: Your presentation was a bit long. The slides looked brilliant, **though**.
sentences.translation: Taqdimotingiz biroz cho'zilib ketdi. Slaydlar **esa** zo'r chiqqan edi.

sentences.text: Madina's cousin seems nice. I didn't understand a word he said, **though**!
sentences.translation: Madinaning amakivachchasi yoqimli yigitga o'xshaydi. **Faqat** aytgan gaplaridan birortasini ham tushunmadim!

sentences.text: Thanks for the invitation. I'm afraid I can't come on Saturday, **though**.
sentences.translation: Taklif uchun rahmat. **Lekin**, afsuski, shanba kuni kela olmayman.

sentences.text: This phone is cheap and fast. Its battery doesn't last very long, **though**.
sentences.translation: Bu telefon arzon va tez. **Biroq** batareyasi uzoqqa chidamaydi.

sentences.text: Tom says he's feeling fine. He looked really pale at breakfast, **though**.
sentences.translation: Tom o'zini yaxshi his qilayotganini aytyapti. **Holbuki** nonushtada rangi juda oqarib ketgan edi.

sentences.text: Jasur isn't the most talented player in the squad. Nobody trains harder than him, **though**.
sentences.translation: Jasur jamoadagi eng iste'dodli o'yinchi emas. **Lekin** undan ko'ra qattiqroq mashq qiladigan odam yo'q.

examples.title: Dialogue: a rainy weekend in Edinburgh
examples.description: Ikki do'st sayohat haqida gaplashadi: although, even though, despite, in spite of va gap oxiridagi though bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — How was Edinburgh? I heard you went **despite** the storm warnings.
sentences.translation: — Edinburg qanday bo'ldi? Bo'ron haqidagi ogohlantirishlarga **qaramay** borgan ekansan.

sentences.text: — We did! **Although** it rained almost every day, we had a fantastic time.
sentences.translation: — Bordik! Deyarli har kuni yomg'ir **yog'gan bo'lsa ham**, ajoyib dam oldik.

sentences.text: — Really? I'd have cancelled the trip, **even though** everything was already paid for.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Hammasi oldindan to'langan **bo'lsa ham**, men safarni bekor qilgan bo'lardim.

sentences.text: — The city looked magical **in spite of** the grey sky, especially the castle.
sentences.translation: — Kulrang osmonga **qaramay**, shahar sehrli ko'rinardi, ayniqsa qal'a.

sentences.text: — And the hotel? Sarah said it cost a fortune, **though**.
sentences.translation: — Mehmonxona-chi? Sara **esa** u juda qimmatga tushgan dedi-ku.

sentences.text: — It did, and **despite** the price, our room was tiny and noisy.
sentences.translation: — Ha, qimmat edi, narxiga **qaramay**, xonamiz kichkina va shovqinli edi.

sentences.text: — Did you ask to change rooms, **even though** you hate complaining?
sentences.translation: — Shikoyat qilishni yomon **ko'rsang ham**, xonani almashtirishni so'radingmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, and **although** the receptionist looked annoyed, she moved us upstairs.
sentences.translation: — Ha, administrator norozi **ko'ringan bo'lsa ham**, bizni yuqori qavatga ko'chirdi.

sentences.text: — Good for you! So, **despite** everything, would you go back?
sentences.translation: — Barakalla! Xo'sh, hamma narsaga **qaramay**, yana borarmiding?

sentences.text: — Definitely, **though** next time I'll pack a much better umbrella!
sentences.translation: — Albatta, **faqat** keyingi safar ancha yaxshiroq soyabon olib olaman!

examples.title: Mixed: news, work and everyday life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: gap kelsa — although / though / even though, ot yoki -ing kelsa — despite / in spite of.

sentences.text: **Despite** rising fuel costs, the airline has promised not to raise ticket prices this summer.
sentences.translation: Yoqilg'i narxi **oshayotganiga qaramay**, aviakompaniya bu yoz chipta narxlarini oshirmaslikka va'da berdi.

sentences.text: The new law was passed **although** most doctors had spoken out against it.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning ko'pchiligi unga qarshi chiqqan **bo'lsa ham**, yangi qonun qabul qilindi.

sentences.text: **Even though** the app is free, it collects a surprising amount of personal data.
sentences.translation: Ilova bepul **bo'lsa ham**, u hayratlanarli darajada ko'p shaxsiy ma'lumot yig'adi.

sentences.text: Our flat stays cool in summer **in spite of** facing south.
sentences.translation: Derazalari janubga **qaragan bo'lsa ham**, kvartiramiz yozda salqin bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Nilufar finished the marathon **despite** injuring her ankle halfway through.
sentences.translation: Yo'lning yarmida to'pig'ini **shikastlaganiga qaramay**, Nilufar marafonni oxirigacha yugurib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Though** he rarely gives interviews, the director agreed to speak to a student newspaper.
sentences.translation: Kamdan-kam intervyu **bersa ham**, rejissyor talabalar gazetasi bilan suhbatlashishga rozi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Fewer people are buying newspapers, **despite the fact that** reliable news has never been more important.
sentences.translation: Ishonchli yangiliklar hech qachon bunchalik muhim **bo'lmaganiga qaramay**, gazeta sotib oluvchilar kamaymoqda.

sentences.text: **In spite of** a long career in banking, James decided to retrain as a nurse at forty-five.
sentences.translation: Bank sohasidagi uzoq faoliyatiga **qaramay**, Jeyms qirq besh yoshida hamshiralikka qayta o'qishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: The two countries signed the agreement, **although** several key questions remain unanswered.
sentences.translation: Bir qancha asosiy savollar javobsiz **qolayotgan bo'lsa ham**, ikki davlat kelishuvni imzoladi.

sentences.text: My parents still prefer to pay in cash. Cards are much more convenient, **though**.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam hali ham naqd pul bilan to'lashni afzal ko'radi. **Holbuki** karta ancha qulayroq.
